mapper.select: SELECT r."対象日" AS "date", EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM r."対象日")::int AS "weekday", COUNT(l."日報授業ID")::int AS "lessonCount", AVG(l."掌握度") AS "averageMastery", COUNT(l."日報授業ID") FILTER (WHERE l."ノート記録フラグ")::int AS "noteCount", r."提出状態コード" AS "submitStatus", (r."提出状態コード" = 'SUBMITTED') AS "submitted", r."提出日時" AS "submittedAt", COALESCE( (SELECT STRING_AGG(sub.subj, ',' ORDER BY sub.first_period) FROM (SELECT l2."教科名" AS subj, MIN(l2."時限") AS first_period FROM public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" l2 WHERE l2."日報ID" = r."日報ID" GROUP BY l2."教科名") sub), '' ) AS "subjectsCsv", COUNT(l."日報授業ID") FILTER ( WHERE COALESCE(BTRIM(l."授業内容"), '') != '' OR l."掌握度" IS NOT NULL )::int AS "detailedLessonCount", r."休日区分コード" AS "holidayType", r."全体の振り返り" AS "review", r."今夜宿題内容" AS "homework" FROM public."TRN_学習日報情報" r LEFT JOIN public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" l ON l."日報ID" = r."日報ID" WHERE r."アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND r."対象日" BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY r."日報ID", r."対象日", r."提出状態コード", r."提出日時", r."休日区分コード", r."全体の振り返り", r."今夜宿題内容" ORDER BY r."対象日"

SELECT weekday, period, subject, appearances, days FROM ( SELECT agg.weekday, agg.period, agg.subject, agg.appearances, agg.days, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY agg.weekday, agg.period ORDER BY agg.appearances DESC, agg.subject) AS rn FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM r."対象日")::int AS weekday, l."時限" AS period, l."教科名" AS subject, COUNT(*)::int AS appearances, COUNT(DISTINCT r."対象日")::int AS days FROM public."TRN_学習日報情報" r JOIN public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" l ON l."日報ID" = r."日報ID" WHERE r."アカウントID" = #{accountId} GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ) agg ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY weekday, period

SELECT "日報ID", "アカウントID", "旧ユーザーID", "対象日", "全体の振り返り", "学習集中度", "理解度", "学習量", "学習態度", "今夜宿題内容", "備考", "提出状態コード", "提出日時", "休日区分コード", "登録日時", "更新日時" FROM public."TRN_学習日報情報" WHERE "アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "対象日" = #{date}

SELECT "時限" AS "period", "教科名" AS "subject", "授業内容" AS "content", "掌握度" AS "mastery", "ノート記録フラグ" AS "noteRecorded", "ノート記載しない理由" AS "noteSkippedReason", "学習集中度" AS "concentration", "学習量" AS "studyVolume", "学習態度" AS "attitude" FROM public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" WHERE "日報ID" = #{reportId} ORDER BY "時限"
SELECT "表示順" AS "order", "教科名" AS "subject", "学習内容" AS "content" FROM public."TRN_学習日報科目情報" WHERE "日報ID" = #{reportId} ORDER BY "表示順"

SELECT r."対象日" AS "date", l."時限" AS "period", l."教科名" AS "subject", l."授業内容" AS "content", l."掌握度" AS "mastery", l."ノート記録フラグ" AS "noteRecorded", l."ノート記載しない理由" AS "noteSkippedReason", l."学習集中度" AS "concentration", l."学習量" AS "studyVolume", l."学習態度" AS "attitude" FROM public."TRN_学習日報情報" r JOIN public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" l ON l."日報ID" = r."日報ID" WHERE r."アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND r."対象日" BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY r."対象日", l."時限"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public."TRN_学習日報情報" ("アカウントID", "対象日", "登録元コード") VALUES (#{accountId}, #{date}, 'APP') ON CONFLICT ("アカウントID", "対象日") DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" ( "日報ID", "時限", "教科名", "授業内容", "掌握度", "ノート記録フラグ", "ノート記載しない理由", "学習集中度", "学習量", "学習態度", "登録元コード") VALUES ( #{reportId}, #{period}, #{subject}, #{content}, #{mastery}, #{noteRecorded}, #{noteSkippedReason}, #{concentration}, #{studyVolume}, #{attitude}, 'APP') ON CONFLICT ("日報ID", "時限") DO UPDATE SET "教科名" = EXCLUDED."教科名", "授業内容" = EXCLUDED."授業内容", "掌握度" = EXCLUDED."掌握度", "ノート記録フラグ" = EXCLUDED."ノート記録フラグ", "ノート記載しない理由" = EXCLUDED."ノート記載しない理由", "学習集中度" = EXCLUDED."学習集中度", "学習量" = EXCLUDED."学習量", "学習態度" = EXCLUDED."学習態度", "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE public."TRN_学習日報情報" SET "休日区分コード" = #{holidayType}, "全体の振り返り" = #{review}, "今夜宿題内容" = #{homework}, "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "日報ID" = #{reportId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" WHERE "日報ID" = #{reportId}
DELETE FROM public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" WHERE "日報ID" = #{reportId} AND "時限" = #{period}
mapper.update: UPDATE public."TRN_学習日報情報" SET "休日区分コード" = 'NORMAL', "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "対象日" = #{date} AND "休日区分コード" != 'NORMAL'
mapper.select: SELECT "日報ID", "アカウントID", "旧ユーザーID", "対象日", "全体の振り返り", "学習集中度", "理解度", "学習量", "学習態度", "今夜宿題内容", "備考", "提出状態コード", "提出日時", "休日区分コード", "登録日時", "更新日時" FROM public."TRN_学習日報情報" WHERE "アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "対象日" BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY "対象日"
SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM public."TRN_学習日報情報" r JOIN public."TRN_学習日報授業情報" l ON l."日報ID" = r."日報ID" WHERE r."アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND r."対象日" = #{date}
mapper.update: UPDATE public."TRN_学習日報情報" SET "提出状態コード" = 'SUBMITTED', "提出日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新元コード" = 'APP', "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "対象日" = #{date} AND "提出状態コード" != 'SUBMITTED'

UPDATE public."TRN_学習日報情報" SET "提出状態コード" = 'DRAFT', "バージョン" = "バージョン" + 1, "更新者アカウントID" = #{accountId}, "更新日時" = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE "アカウントID" = #{accountId} AND "対象日" = #{date} AND "提出状態コード" = 'SUBMITTED'
